description: Return non-secret install, browser-confirmed pairing and run instructions for an ee-database sync client. Requires owner and a sync-enabled plan; no LLM call and no credential is issued or exposed to the MCP client. Run pair_command on the intended replica host: the CLI opens verification_url, the user chooses the database and confirms, and the credential travels directly to the polling CLI. Its DSN stays on that host. Use manual pairing only when managed host provisioning is not already handling the registration. Setup: enricher://docs/database-sync.
name: get_database_setup_instructions
title: Get database setup instructions
